build_cmd: find /build -name '*.o' -size 0 -delete 2>/dev/null; tc-sync-mtimes /build/.tc_md5 double-conversion test && ( [ -f /build/CMakeCache.txt ] || cmake -S /w -B /build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=None -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-O1 -DBUILD_TESTING=ON >/dev/null ) && rm -f /build/test/cctest/cctest && cmake --build /build -- -j4 2>&1 | grep -E 'error' | head -40; test -x /build/test/cctest/cctest
test_cmd: cd /build/test/cctest && for t in $(./cctest --list | sed 's/<.*//'); do if timeout 120 ./cctest $t >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "TCRESULT PASS $t"; else echo "TCRESULT FAIL $t"; fi; done
notes: CMake (BUILD_TESTING=ON) configured once into /build (volume), -O1 without -g. cctest aborts the process on the first failed CHECK, so test_cmd lists all tests (cctest --list) and runs each 'file/name' in its own process, giving per-test pass/fail. The cctest binary is deleted before each build so a failed compile never runs a stale binary.
